- Net.Amount: "Netto EUR 1.990,08" — net amount corresponding to the VAT group shown.

4) Numeric normalization decisions (no guessing)
- Preserve decimal precision as in input:

  - "398,02" → 398.02
  - "2.388,10" → 2388.10
- Vat.Rate as number without "%" → 20

5) Final chosen extractions (confirmed and unambiguous)
- Invoice.Date = "25.01.2024"
- Sender.VatId = "ATU49325305"
- GrandTotal.Amount = 2388.10
- Net.Amount = 1990.08
- Vat.Rate = 20
